READ_ONLY.notes: FortiOS primary surface is REST API. CLI entries are serial fallback.

CONFIG_REVERSIBLE.notes: Lab-verified for FortiOS 7.x. All applies use 'config ... end' blocks; rollback is automatic via revision history.

entries.template:
config system global
 set hostname <hostname>
end
entries.rollback:
config system global
 unset hostname
end

entries.template:
config system interface
 edit <intf>
  set ip <ip> <mask>
  set allowaccess ping https ssh
 end
entries.rollback:
config system interface
 edit <intf>
  unset ip
 end

entries.template:
config system interface
 edit <intf>
  set vlanid <vlan_id>
 end
entries.rollback:
config system interface
 edit <intf>
  unset vlanid
 end

entries.template:
config system dns
 set primary <ip>
 set secondary <ip>
end
entries.rollback:
config system dns
 unset primary
 unset secondary
end

CONFIG_HIGH_RISK.notes: Routing-protocol and policy templates. Require explicit human confirmation.

entries.template:
config router static
 edit <id>
  set dst <net>
  set gateway <gw>
  set device <intf>
 end

config firewall policy
 edit <id>
  set srcintf <intf>
  set dstintf <intf>
  set action accept
  set srcaddr all
  set dstaddr all
  set schedule always
  set service ALL
 end

entries.purpose: never executed by platform; HUMAN_TASK instructions only
